description: Production WAF rules protecting adhdcompass.in against secret scrapers, hostile subnets, and unmasked bots
name: ADHD Compass Custom WAF Ruleset

rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains ".env") or (http.request.uri.path contains ".tfstate") or (http.request.uri.path contains "wp-config") or (http.request.uri.path contains ".git") or (http.request.uri.path contains ".bak") or (http.request.uri.path contains ".swp") or (http.request.uri.path contains "phpinfo") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/terraform")
((http.user_agent contains "TLM-Audit-Scanner") or (http.user_agent contains "curl/") or (http.user_agent contains "python-requests")) and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/webhooks"))
